description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Square' which renders a button representing a cell in a Tic Tac Toe board. It manages accessibility labels, styles, and click behavior, and includes helper functions for position labeling.

methods.name: Square
methods.description: React functional component that renders a Tic Tac Toe board cell with accessibility and styling.

methods.name: indexToPositionString
methods.description: Converts a 0-based index to a human-readable board position string (row,col).
